text:
incident-bot: Pager: kv-cache size and continuous-batching queue growth detected on prod-gpu-pool-7. 95th latency spike for batch paths, memory pressure on 3 hosts, elevated 502s from frontends. Auto-escalating to eng-sre and eng-runtime. docs/incident-template link: https://internal/reports/INC-1778004321

avery: acknowledged. I'm taking first oncall. tagging runtime + platform.

priya: looking at traces now — continuous_batching hot path showing unbounded prefix growth for requests with many short-turn interactions (~60% of requests). KV cache miss rate is down but cached entries are huge due to a bug in prefix pruning. hypothesis: prefix pruning edge-case triggered by combined streaming+function-calls (new-ish handler).

marta: customer impact? which tenants seeing errors vs degraded latency?

priya: telemetry shows most 502s correlate to OOMs on worker nodes that started evicting caches. Heavy tenant: acme-marketing (traffic pattern: lots of short messages + large instructions) accounts for ~42% of mem pressure.

avery: OK. mitigation options: 1) global disable continuous_batching (fast, broad), 2) reduce max_batch_size for gpu pools (safer), 3) feature-flag per-customer overrides for hot tenants. We should canary before global flip.

josh: platform constraint: global disable will route more requests and increase per-token cost and latency SLO risk. But if we can target pool:prod-gpu-pool-7 and do a canary of 10% of traffic, that seems lowest blast radius.

priya: agree. propose immediate hotfix: set batch.max_size=64 and continuous_batching.enabled=false for canary subset (pool:prod-gpu-pool-7, canary 10%). If stable for 15m, expand to 50% then full. Also push pruning fix to next patch but that requires validation.

avery: do it. I'll coordinate canary. @deploy-bot can you apply the flag for canary? include rollback command.

deploy-bot: Starting feature-toggle: 
```
rctl feature-set --name=batch-config-hotfix --set "continuous_batching=false,max_batch_size=64" \
  --scope="pool:prod-gpu-pool-7" --canary=10 --initiator=avery
```
Canary rollout started at 1778004520. Monitor: /dashboards/kv-cache-pressure and /alerts/504-rate.

marta: adding quick per-customer override for acme-marketing to reduce batch size to 32 immediately (reduce their memory footprint). Command: `rctl feature-set --name=acme-override --set "max_batch_size=32" --scope="tenant:acme-marketing" --force`

josh: note: per-tenant override will change unit economics for that tenant. Finance heads-up: cc @finance if we need to bill differently.

priya: canary telemetry at +3m: queue depth on canary hosts down ~40%, memory delta normalized, no new OOMs on canary. latency P50 up ~6ms. Good signal.

avery: expand canary to 50% now. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: Canary expanded to 50% at 1778004722. No deploy failures.

priya: telemetry at +10m after expansion: P95 down significantly, 502 rate returning to baseline, acme-marketing per-tenant override holding. No new evictions.

marta: OK to proceed to global for pool (not global across all pools) in 5m unless objections. We should keep continuous_batching disabled until pruning fix merges and is verified.

josh: agreed. Also add a temporary alert to warn if any worker >80% memory for more than 2m.

avery: rolling to 100% for pool:prod-gpu-pool-7 at 1778005010.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 1778005036. Changes applied: continuous_batching=false, max_batch_size=64 for scope=pool:prod-gpu-pool-7. Per-tenant acme-marketing override remains at max_batch_size=32.

priya: follow-up: creating PR for prefix-pruning fix (PR: internal/infra#1258). CI includes load repro. Scheduling validation on staging with streaming+function-call combos.

avery: customer comms: SRE to draft note for impacted customers: acme-marketing saw degraded throughput but no data loss; we've applied per-tenant override and pool fix; full revert not required. @marta can you own the comms?

marta: on it. will send template by EOD.

avery: handoff: I'm going to hand oncall to @priya in 25m. leaving runbook steps in the thread and enabling tight monitoring. If metrics regress, rollback command: `rctl feature-unset --name=batch-config-hotfix --scope="pool:prod-gpu-pool-7"`

priya: got it. I'll watch the dashboards. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident log created: INC-1778004321. Summary: KV cache prefix-pruning bug caused unbounded cache entries, triggering continuous-batching-induced memory blowups on prod-gpu-pool-7. Mitigation: staged feature-flag canary reduced batch size and disabled continuous_batching on pool. Per-tenant override for acme-marketing. Follow-ups: PR for fix, additional memory alert, postmortem in 48h.

avery: closing thread for active mitigation; keeping incident open for postmortem.

priya: updating status to watch-only.

marta: posting customer note and creating postmortem placeholder: https://internal/postmortems/INC-1778004321

avery: thanks all.
